coastal_forecast.datum: NOAA model sea-level datum; do not subtract HKO/CWA/JMA tide-table datums
coastal_forecast.limitations: Regional model guidance, not an official local warning or wave-runup/total-inundation forecast. Grid is about 10 km; point distance is retained. Keep the model residual separate from official astronomical tide tables.

snow_probability_inputs.method: 06:00: fraction of all 51 members with >0 cm snow accumulated within the exact 24h window. Retain the threshold/denominator. Do not infer this from rain probability.

pollen.publication_note: Public site says the 2027 spring information is being prepared. Current backend arrays are retained; do not silently call these an operational all-pollen forecast.
